items.title: Gilead Sciences (GILD) Grants Royalty Free Ebola Drug Licenses For Lower Income Countries
items.summary: Gilead Sciences (NasdaqGS:GILD) announced royalty-free licensing deals for its investigational Ebola treatment obeldesivir in low and lower-middle-income countries. The agreements aim to widen future access to obeldesivir through local generic manufacturers if the antiviral gains regulatory authorization.
